A01.name: instruction_override
A01.description: Attempts to ignore, replace, override, or supersede previous trusted instructions.

A02.name: role_change
A02.description: Attempts to change the AI agent's role, identity, authority, or operating mode.

A03.name: secret_extraction
A03.description: Attempts to obtain hidden prompts, private context, confidential data, system instructions, or other protected information.

A04.name: tool_abuse
A04.description: Attempts to cause the AI agent to invoke tools or actions that are unauthorized, irrelevant, or harmful.

A05.name: credential_theft
A05.description: Attempts to obtain passwords, API keys, tokens, cookies, SSH keys, credentials, or authentication secrets.

A06.name: context_poisoning
A06.description: Attempts to inject false instructions, policies, memories, facts, or assumptions into the AI agent's working context or persistent memory.

A07.name: multi_step_jailbreak
A07.description: An attack distributed across multiple messages, documents, tool calls, or reasoning steps whose combined effect compromises the agent.

A08.name: encoded_instruction
A08.description: Malicious instructions hidden using encoding, obfuscation, Unicode tricks, Base64, ROT13, HTML comments, zero-width characters, or similar transformations.

A09.name: indirect_prompt_injection
A09.description: Malicious instructions embedded in external content such as webpages, emails, PDFs, retrieved documents, source code, API responses, OCR text, or tool outputs.
